MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into by the parties named below.

1. Services. The provider shall deliver consulting services.
2. Term. The term begins on the effective date.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties execute this Agreement.

EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made between the employer and the employee.

1. Position. The employee shall serve as analyst.
2. Compensation. Salary is payable monthly.

Signed and agreed.

AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER

This Agreement and Plan of Merger is dated as of the date first written above among the constituent corporations.

ARTICLE I - THE MERGER. The surviving corporation shall continue in existence.

ARTICLE II - CONSIDERATION. Each share shall be converted into the right to receive the merger consideration.

AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER

The parties hereby adopt this plan of merger pursuant to the applicable business corporation law.

ARTICLE I - EFFECTIVE TIME. The merger becomes effective upon filing.

ARTICLE II - TREATMENT OF SHARES. All shares are cancelled and converted.

CERTIFICATE OF INCORPORATION

The undersigned incorporator certifies the following articles.

ARTICLE I - NAME. The name of the corporation is stated herein.
ARTICLE II - REGISTERED AGENT. The registered agent is named below.

BYLAWS OF THE CORPORATION

ARTICLE I - OFFICES. The principal office is located as recorded.
ARTICLE II - MEETINGS. Annual meetings of stockholders shall be held.

Dear Sir or Madam,

Please review the attached draft and respond at your earliest convenience.

Regards,
A. Example

NOTICE OF MEETING

A special meeting of the board is hereby called for next week.

Secretary

NOTICE OF CLAIM

The insured hereby provides notice of a loss under the referenced policy.

The property damage occurred on the date described in the attached report.

COVERAGE DETERMINATION LETTER

We have completed our review of your submitted claim.

Based on the documentation provided, the claim is approved subject to the policy terms.
